title: eMRTD differential harness
description: Differential test harness for open-source eMRTD reader libraries. Identical synthetic chip profiles are replayed against multiple stacks; each run captures APDU traces and classifies whether negotiation failures or specification-permitted downgrades reach a typical application caller (Observability Score). Synthetic APDU profiles only; not RF / silicon. Cite SemVer tag v1.0.4. Locked full-run trees for independent hash verification are published as a separate GitHub Release / Zenodo dataset deposit.
notes: When the JISA manuscript receives a DOI, add it here as related_identifiers with relation isSupplementTo (software) / isDocumentedBy (paper) as appropriate. Do not mint a Zenodo DOI for locked-run trees from a pre-sanitization archive.
